تفترضوا (form VIII)
# تَفْتَرِضُوا (taftariḍū) /taf.ta.ri.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
# تُفْتَرَضُوا (tuftaraḍū) /tuf.ta.ra.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
